steps.caption: The price book
steps.narration: Let's add a new item to your price book.

steps.caption: Name
steps.narration: Give the item a name your crew and your clients will recognise.

steps.caption: Code: automatic
steps.narration: Leave Code empty, and the item gets the next SKU number.

steps.caption: Unit
steps.narration: Pick the unit you sell it by. Crown molding is priced per linear foot.

steps.caption: Pricing mode: Flat price
steps.narration: Pricing mode stays on Flat price: one price for each unit.

steps.caption: Price
steps.narration: Type the price for one unit.

steps.caption: Cost (optional)
steps.narration: Cost is optional. It's what the item costs you.

steps.value:
• Supply and install 4.5" primed crown
• Caulk joints and fill nail holes
• Ready for paint
steps.caption: Scope of work
steps.narration: Then write the scope of work. It shows on every estimate built from this item.

steps.caption: Add SKU
steps.narration: Choose Add SKU to save it.

steps.caption: Find the new item
steps.narration: The new item is in your Price Chart. Search to find it.

steps.caption: Name, code, price, scope
steps.narration: It has its code, its price per foot and your scope of work.

steps.caption: Quantity
steps.narration: To check it, type a quantity.

steps.caption: Total, cost, margin
steps.narration: Sixty-four feet comes to this total, with your cost and margin underneath.

steps.caption: Ready for estimates
steps.narration: The item is now ready to add to any new estimate.

steps.caption: Menu: Price book
steps.narration: You'll find Price book in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to add a price book item | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of adding an item to the price book in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will name the item, pick its unit, set a price and an optional cost, write the scope of work, save it, and preview a quantity.
